about.text: Also known as Mantecoso (English: "buttery") and Fresco (English: "fresh"), Cremoso cheese is defined by the Argentine Food Code as a "high and very high moisture product, made from whole milk or standardized milk, with or without the addition of cream, acidified by lactic bacteria culture and coagulated by rennet and/or specific enzymes."
